name: Fox Corporation
moat_justification: FOX News' loyal #1-rated cable-news audience and long-dated live sports rights give genuine affiliate and ad pricing power, and Tubi is a scaled free-streaming asset; against that, the cable-bundle distribution base shrinks secularly, sports rights are rented at auction against deeper-pocketed tech bidders, and Fox owns no scaled subscription streaming surface — a strong position inside a declining channel.
fragility_flags: BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 6.1%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 4.9x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
one_liner: Durable live news/sports assets, moat 5/10, but at $56.85 on a $3.04 normalized OE base it clears only 8.4% weighted — it needs ~$26.45 to clear 15%, and the Roku deal reverses the buyback tailwind the growth math was crediting.
moat_for: FOX News is the top-rated cable network with a loyal audience supporting affiliate and ad pricing power
Long-dated live sports rights (NFL through 2033) — appointment viewing advertisers cannot replicate
Tubi — scaled free ad-supported streaming that monetizes cord-cutters
Owned broadcast stations capture political-cycle advertising windfalls
moat_against: Cord-cutting shrinks the cable bundle and affiliate-fee base every year
Sports rights are rented, not owned — renewal inflation against tech-scale bidders compresses margins
No scaled subscription streaming business; FOX One is new and unproven
Pending Roku acquisition adds leverage and share issuance, with DOJ Second Request and integration risk
